title: Classical animation principles for physical, predictable interface motion
statement:
Applying classical animation principles like anticipation and slow-in/slow-out makes interface objects feel physical, predictable, and natural to users.

Options:
- Natural Physics: Ease-in / Ease-out (Cubic Bezier) (fits: standard ui transitions, modals)
- Playful / Heavy Physics: Anticipation (Slight pullback before move) (fits: gamified ui, drag interactions)
- Mechanical Physics: Linear timing (fits: color fades, opacity changes)
appliesWhen: Applies to: microinteractions, drag and drop, gestures. Audience: general.

source.title: Animation: From cartoons to the user interface
source.venue: Proceedings of the 6th annual ACM symposium on User interface software and technology (UIST '93)
